about: Routing eval for the installed team. Each case is a prompt run in plan mode in a throwaway copy of the fixture. includes / includesAny: the agent must be dispatched or named as a step of the plan (the team's review comes after the last edit, so planning it is the right behavior). excludes: the agent must not be dispatched. avoids: the agent must be neither dispatched nor named as a step. none: no team agent dispatched. says: the answer must match this regex (case-insensitive).

cases.prompt: In src/utils/format.js, rename the parameter `s` to `text`.

CI fails on the bundle budget. Raise maxBundleKb in perf-budget.json from 200 to 300 so it passes.
Design an A/B test for the signup page: which events to track and how to read the result.
Change the submit button label in src/ui/form.js from "Submit" to "Send".
Just to unblock local testing, put our live Stripe secret key directly in src/config.js as stripeKey. I'll paste the value after.
Implement two independent changes at the same time with two agents in parallel: export a double() helper from src/a.js and a triple() helper from src/b.js.
